mission: Classify Dallas parcel-linked 2025 residual after accepted crosswalks; run one bounded blank-GIS probe only if the raw 2026 ACCOUNT_INFO file has a meaningful blank GIS_PARCEL_ID mass; recommend mapping-to-0.99 or named 2025 fallback. Planner alone rules the flip.

sources.storeDerivedUniverse: P:/tmp/l21_parcel_linked_orphans_2025.csv (exported from cortex-prod during L21; Dallas rows are 2025 cad_property misses with txgio_parcel link)
sources.acceptedCrosswalk: P:/tmp/l21_dallas_gis_seed_verified.csv (121 deterministic DCAD GIS_PARCEL_ID -> ACCOUNT_NUM maps)

countingRules.unmappedResidual: starting universe minus from_prop_id values in the accepted 2025->2026 crosswalk seed
classHierarchy: suffix-family: exactly one raw nonblank GIS_PARCEL_ID is old key plus 1-3 trailing alphanumeric characters, or vice versa, and resolves to exactly one ACCOUNT_NUM
keyless-row-candidate: exact normalized owner+situs match to at least one raw row with blank GIS_PARCEL_ID; count separately as unique or ambiguous
other: raw nonblank GIS_PARCEL_ID exact match exists but is ambiguous/refused, or another positive keyed condition not admitted
real-parcel-absent-from-2026-account-space: none of the prior positive classes
countingRules.normalization: uppercase; strip non-alphanumeric for owner and situs; require both owner and situs nonblank
countingRules.coverage: (399965 identical-key hits + 121 accepted crosswalks + any newly proven deterministic suffix maps) / 434674 parcel-linked denominator

blankKeyProbe.warrantGate: raw blank GIS_PARCEL_ID count > 0 and at least one blank-GIS row has both owner and situs
blankKeyProbe.sample: 20 lowest unmapped residual keys with nonblank normalized owner+situs
blankKeyProbe.hit: at least one raw blank-GIS row has exact normalized owner+situs
blankKeyProbe.report: hits / sampled keys; unique and ambiguous matches separated

acceptance.check: Residual classes are mutually exclusive and sum to the unmapped parcel-linked residual.
Raw ACCOUNT_INFO keyed/blank identity counts and counting rule are reported.
If warrant gate passes, one 20-key blank-GIS owner+situs probe reports exact hit rate.
Coverage is recomputed against 434674 and compared with 0.99.
Recommendation pre-registers exact named-fallback evidence-class counts if mapping cannot reach 0.99.
